security_privacy_cost_impact: No secret, credential, tenant data, provider, migration or database is touched. RFC-2026-030 is process text, inert until §9's conditions hold; the classifier only reads git objects, with argument arrays (no shell), literal pathspecs and no network, and only ever raises a tier. Its denylists (path words, identifiers, sinks) are disclosed in §4.5; L's import allowlist and the empty module allowlist are the fail-closed parts. Cost: once in effect, M and L PRs drop per-PR Integration Owner readings for an end-of-package R0 verdict (at the latest every 10 merged M/L PRs or 7 days). No token or time figure is claimed.
migration_and_data_impact: None. No migration, policy, grant, probe or catalog change.
compatibility_impact: Tests on main bd019c9c: 725; this branch: 726 (one review-tier test in foundation-contract): the foundation-contract floor, name digest and assertion floor in scripts/test-suite-contract.mjs; RFC-2026-030 and the classifier on DIGESTED_FLOOR and in test-kits/integrity-manifest.json; RFC-2026-030 on DECISION_RECORDS in test-kits/repository-json.test.mjs; the branch slot in test-kits/branch-identity.test.mjs; line pins in db/foundation/lint/audit-coverage-map.json; evidence/VERIFICATION.md by record:verification. No existing guard changes behaviour; nothing runs the classifier in CI yet.
known_limitations: The path-word, identifier and sink lists are denylists (RFC §4.5): C0 N3, A1-R3, Q0 QR2, QR5, R0 R-12 misses are disclosed, for the first allowlist-opening PR to pin.

Neutral evidence admits an append to another role's verdict or one other package's record, and an evidence/VERIFICATION.md rewrite (Q0 QR4, A1-R4, R0 R-13); with every module path H and no L path these decide no PR today.
'Behind a flag', 'no data path' and M's 'with tests' are confirmed in writing by a reader, not decided by the script (§4.1, §4.3).
The handoff guard compares path sets against HEAD^ and can read green before a refresh (A1-R5, Q0 QR6, R0 R-10); 'last and alone' is measured with git show --stat as well.
